experiment: Single frozen evidence_checked prompt candidate versus evidence_first
review: Same root agent checks frozen gold against original final answers. Not an independent second reviewer.
candidate_acceptance: Development quality improves by at least one case; holdout quality does not regress; empty-evidence refusal and explicit-zero facts both pass; report full cost and output-length changes. No default promotion without subsequent Reader/retrieval/end-to-end validation.
scope: 8 exposed development cases and 8 new author-controlled holdout cases; not an external blind benchmark.
